extracted.name: Meyer Lemon Avocado Toast
extracted.description: This avocado toast recipe, made with Meyer lemon juice and zest, is topped with chia seeds for a hearty, vegan snack or lunch that is quick and easy.
ingredient_lines: 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro, or more to taste
1 teaspoon Meyer lemon juice, or to taste
instruction_lines: Toast bread slices to desired doneness, 3 to 5 minutes.
Mash avocado in a medium bowl; stir in cilantro, Meyer lemon zest, Meyer lemon juice, cayenne pepper, and sea salt until well combined. Spread avocado mixture onto toast; top with chia seeds.
